details:
Implementation Plan

Clarification mapping:
- No `Q<ID>` clarification questions were issued in clarify phase.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` maps to “no unresolved clarifications; proceed with planning.”

Factual conflicts detected between issue text and current code:
- Validation currently runs from the default branch context, not an integration branch context. `validate.yml` checks out the workflow ref, and poller dispatch does not currently set `--ref` to an integration branch.
- `build_tracking_state()` currently has no `integration_branch` input/output, and `rebuild_tracking_state()` cannot recover it from tracking body today.
- Final completion paths are split: judge `complete` path (validation disabled) and `mark_validation_complete()` path (validation enabled). Final merge logic must be wired into both.
- `review_autofix.yml` already uses PR base ref (`.base.ref`) as `BASE_BRANCH`; no hardcoded `main` found in conflict resolution path.

Implementation plan (checklist):
1. [ ] Extend orchestrator state schema for integration mode in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`.
- Add optional fields with backward-compatible defaults:
- `integration_branch: ""`
- `final_merge_strategy: "squash"`
- `final_merge_pr: null` (or equivalent)
- `final_merge_status: "pending"` (or equivalent)
- Update `build_tracking_state(...)` signature to accept integration branch.
- Add integration branch line to tracking body output and parse support in `parse_tracking_body()` so `rebuild_tracking_state()` can recover it.

2. [ ] Create and persist integration branch at project bootstrap in `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml`.
- After tracking issue creation and before Wave 1 issue creation:
- Resolve default branch via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`.
- Create deterministic branch `orchestrator/project-${TRACKING_ISSUE_NUMBER}` from default HEAD using:
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/{default}`
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs` (`ref`, `sha`)
- Make branch creation idempotent (skip if already exists).
- Pass `integration_branch` into state build call.
- Ensure tracking issue body includes visible integration branch line.

3. [ ] Propagate integration branch metadata to all orchestrator-managed child issues.
- Add `- Integration branch: <name>` in issue metadata footer for:
- Wave 1 issues in `orchestrate.yml`.
- Deferred wave issues created in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- Judge-created/reissued issues in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- Validation fix-up issues in `scripts/validate_process.sh`.
- This ensures implement workflow always has a single metadata source.

4. [ ] Route implementation PR base to integration branch in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`.
- Parse `integration_branch` from issue body metadata.
- Validate/sanitize branch name and verify existence via API before use.
- Set `PR_BASE_BRANCH`:
- metadata value when present and valid
- fallback to `${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}` for legacy/non-orchestrator.
- Replace `gh pr create --base ...` to use `PR_BASE_BRANCH`.

5. [ ] Add poller integration sync and final merge orchestration in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- Add periodic default→integration sync for integration-mode projects using:
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/merges` (`base=integration`, `head=default`)
- Treat up-to-date as non-failure; treat conflict as warning/comment; treat missing branch as terminal failure for project.
- Add final integration→default squash merge helper:
- Create/fetch final PR (`base=default`, `head=integration`), squash merge, delete integration branch.
- Persist final PR/result in state to avoid duplicate merges.
- Invoke helper in both completion flows:
- judge `complete` when validation disabled
- `mark_validation_complete()` when validation enabled
- On final merge conflict: set state to merge-conflict status, post actionable tracking comment, keep project open (do not mark complete).

6. [ ] Ensure validation runs against integration branch state.
- In poller validation dispatch, when `integration_branch` exists, dispatch validate workflow with `--ref <integration_branch>`.
- Keep legacy behavior for empty `integration_branch`.
- This aligns validation with pre-main integrated code.

7. [ ] Adjust standalone conflict sweep in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- Fetch PR base refs during sweep.
- Skip PRs whose base is an active integration branch (or `orchestrator/project-*`), since those are handled by integration sync/final merge flow.

8. [ ] Audit-only for `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`.
- Keep as-is unless regression discovered; it already merges/conflict-checks against PR base branch.
- Add note/test coverage to prevent future hardcoded-default-branch regressions.

Files likely to change:
- `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml`
- `.github/workflows/implement.yml`
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- `scripts/validate_process.sh`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`
- `README.md`

Data structures affected:
- Orchestrator state JSON (`ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1`) with new optional integration/final-merge fields.
- Tracking issue markdown body gains integration branch field.
- Orchestrator issue metadata footer gains integration branch field.

API/interface changes:
- Internal orchestration interface changes only (state + issue metadata).
- No user command changes (`/answer`, `/approved`, `/reclarify` unchanged).
- GitHub API usage additions/updates:
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/{branch}`
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs`
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/merges`
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}`
- `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}/update-branch`

Risks and edge cases:
- Integration branch deleted externally mid-project.
- Default branch force-push causing sync or final merge failure.
- Final squash merge conflict after successful validation.
- Duplicate final PR creation in retry cycles (requires state guard).
- Legacy in-flight projects with no `integration_branch` field (must remain unchanged).

Testing considerations:
- Extend `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py`:
- state includes integration fields with legacy defaults
- tracking body parse/rebuild roundtrip for integration branch
- Extend `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` with mocked `gh` store:
- integration sync attempted in integration mode
- validation dispatch uses integration ref
- validation-disabled completion performs final merge before complete
- validation-enabled completion performs final merge after validation pass
- final merge conflict sets merge-conflict status and does not complete
- legacy mode (empty integration branch) unchanged behavior
- conflict sweep skips integration-base PRs
- Manual/e2e workflow checks:
- Wave PRs target integration branch
- main remains unchanged until final merge
- integration branch deleted on successful final squash merge
